original_statements: 이유를 분석해봐. 대학동가는 사람들은 셔틀의 선호도가 적어
거리가 가까워서 주로 걸어가려고 해. 대학동 주민인 나도 마찬가지고
오늘은 비가 많이와서 사람들이 셔틀을 좀 더 선호하는데도 불구하고 줄이 엄청 짧았다는 것을 감안해

interpretation.usual_behavior: User reports that Daehak-dong residents often favor walking because home is relatively close, and identifies as a resident with this preference.
interpretation.weather_context: User reports heavy rain today and a relative increase in shuttle preference despite the short observed queue.
interpretation.queue_phase: Retain the linked event's full departure followed by one residual waiter. Do not turn the short-queue description into a measured pre-boarding count or an all-day queue maximum.
interpretation.rain_record_type: qualitative user report; not independently verified meteorological data

not_measured: numerical rain effect on mode choice
exact home locations or individual walking distances
total demand and boarding count of the observed vehicle

evidence_role.use: qualitative mechanism diagnosis and interpretation of the linked observation
evidence_role.notes: The three statements are contextual follow-ups from one reporter, not three independent commuter samples. Rain preference and a small post-departure queue can coexist with a full vehicle.
